summary: refactor(oauth): move ScopeSet and constants to @fxa/accounts/oauth
description:
Because:

- fxa-shared is moving to nx libs, and ScopeSet and the OAuth constants belong in @fxa/accounts/oauth.
- The fxa-shared dist still builds its own ScopeSet copy, which the auth server mixes with the lib copy.

This commit:

- Moves scopes.ts and constants.ts to libs/accounts/oauth and drops the url import.
- Brands ScopeSet.prototype with a Symbol.for key that only coerce() checks.
- Makes the fxa-shared oauth files re-export shims for the remaining legacy users.
- Moves the 47 auth-server importers to @fxa/accounts/oauth.
- Ports the mocha spec to jest with a cross-copy case.

Closes FXA-10667
